title: Eleven Beds and One Chart
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）　|　核心词汇：side　|　正文 303 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 side 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My mother was in hospital for eleven weeks in 1998, in a ward of eleven beds, and I learned more about her from the ① side of a chart than I had in thirty-one years at home. The chart had two columns: what she was given and what it did to her, and the second column was longer. The ② side effects filled a page and nobody had warned us about any of them.

There were two ③ sides in that ward and they did not speak to each other: the nurses, who were there all day and knew everything, and the doctors, who came at seven and knew nothing. The pain was in her ④ side, on the left, and it was a nurse who found it. My mother, who had never ⑤ taken sides in her life, took theirs, and said so, and was not thanked.

She had worked ⑥ on the side for thirty-one years as a dressmaker, and the hospital, which asks everybody what they do, wrote down 'housewife'. She said the word was not wrong, only short, and that there is a ⑦ side to every form that nobody reads, and a side to every person that no form asks about.

There is illness on my father's ⑧ side of the family and none on hers, which she said was the only thing she had ever been smug about. Eleven of us sat ⑨ side by side in that ward on the last afternoon, and none of us could think of anything to say.

She came home in March. The ⑩ side of the bed nearest the window is where she sat for the next nine years, and I sat on the other side, and where I last saw her, in 2007, with a piece of sewing in her lap she had been paid for and never delivered.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: C. n. （争论、对立的）一方；一派
E. 固定搭配：on the side 作为副业；另外
F. 固定搭配：side by side 并排；肩并肩
G. 固定搭配：take sides 偏袒；站到一边
H. n. （家族的）一方；血统（on one's father's side）

items.q: from the side of a chart
The side effects filled a page
There were two sides in that ward
The pain was in her side
who had never taken sides in her life

there is a side to every form
illness on my father's side of the family
sat side by side in that ward
The side of the bed nearest the window

answers.why: the side of ... 意为“……的一侧／一面”，我从一张图表的这一面上了解到的她比在家三十一年还多。
side effects 意为“（药物的）副作用”，写满了整整一页，而人事先毫无提醒。
sides 意为“对立的两方”，护士一方和医生一方互不来往。
side 意为“身体的侧面、肋部”，疼痛在她左侧，是护士发现的。
take sides 意为“偏袒、站队”，她一辈子不站队，这次站在了护士一边。
on the side 意为“作为副业、另外”，她三十一年来一直兼职做裁缝。
a side to ... 意为“……的一面”，每张表格都有一面是没人读的。
on one's side of the family 意为“家族的某一方”，我父亲那边有病史，她那边没有。
side by side 意为“并排、肩并肩”，我们十一个人并排坐在病房里。
the side of the bed 意为“床的这一侧”，靠窗那一边是她此后九年坐的地方。
